title: Review pull requests
description: Comment a code review on every pull request that is opened or updated.

modes.prompt: Review the change for correctness, tests and clarity. Be specific and brief. Read the change with git (git diff, git log). Do not edit files or push.

title: Triage new issues
description: Label each new issue and comment a short summary.

modes.prompt: Read the issue and the code it concerns. Summarise it in two or three sentences and say what it needs.

title: Implement issues on request
description: Plan the fix, implement it and open a pull request when an issue gets the ez label, is assigned to the agent user (`ez-agent`, a placeholder: edit the `if` to your agent's login; anyone with triage access can assign, unlike the comment trigger, which needs write access), gets a /ez implement comment, or Implement is clicked in enzarb.

modes.prompt: Read the issue and the code and write a short plan. Do not edit files.
Implement the plan with small, tested changes.

workflow.description: Implement issues on request (label ez, assignee, /ez implement comment or the Implement button) and open a pull request
workflow.if: (event.name == 'issues' and event.action == 'labeled' and event.label.name == 'ez') or (event.name == 'issues' and event.action == 'assigned' and event.assignee.login == 'ez-agent') or (event.name == 'issue_comment' and event.issue.pull_request is undefined and event.comment.user.type != 'Bot' and event.comment.author_association in ['OWNER', 'MEMBER', 'COLLABORATOR'] and event.comment.body | regex_match('(?im)^[[:space:]]*(/ez|@enzarb)[[:space:]]+implement([[:space:]]|$)')) or event.name == 'manual'

title: Fix failing CI
description: When a CI run fails, try a fix and open a pull request.

modes.prompt: Find why the CI run failed, fix the cause with the smallest change and run the tests.

fix.instruction: The CI run {{ event.workflow_run.name }} failed on {{ event.workflow_run.head_branch }}. See {{ event.workflow_run.html_url }}.
